<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-GB">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Order Up! - British English Restaurant Practice</title>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Caveat:wght@600;700&family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
:root {
    --primary: #49E8CC;
    --primary-dark: #2FC7AC;
    --title: #0EA893;
    --secondary: #D98E82;
    --secondary-dark: #C07268;
    --gold: #D9A441;
    --sepia: #7C6B54;
    --bg-paper: #FAF7F2;
    --card-bg: #FFFDF9;
    --card-border: #E8E2D5;
    --dark: #4A4038;
    --card-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(90,70,50,0.10);
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; }
body { background-color: var(--bg-paper); color: var(--dark); padding: 18px; max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 17px; }
h1, h2, h3 { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; }

header {
    background: var(--card-bg); padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: var(--card-shadow); border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;
}

h1 { color: var(--title); font-size: 2.8rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; }

.btn-print {
    background: var(--gold); color: white; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer; border: none; font-size: 0.95rem;
}
.btn-print:hover { background: #b88628; }

details.app-guide {
    background: #fdfaf5; border: 1px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; margin-bottom: 16px;
}
details.app-guide summary {
    font-weight: 700; color: var(--sepia); cursor: pointer; font-size: 1rem; outline: none;
}
details.app-guide p { font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 8px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--dark); }

.mode-nav { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.mode-btn { flex: 1; min-width: 200px; padding: 12px; font-size: 1.15rem; font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--card-border); background: var(--card-bg); cursor: pointer; }
.mode-btn.active { background: var(--primary); color: var(--dark); border-color: var(--primary-dark); }

.dashboard { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px; }
@media (max-width: 950px) { .dashboard { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

.panel { background: var(--card-bg); border-radius: 18px; padding: 18px; box-shadow: var(--card-shadow); border: 1px solid var(--card-border); }
.panel-full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }

.category-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 10px 0 4px; }
.cat-btn { padding: 9px 13px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--card-border); background: #eee; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.cat-btn.active { background: var(--primary); color: var(--dark); }
.cat-meaning { font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--secondary-dark); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 12px; font-style: italic; }

/* Vertical flashcards */
.dish-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 10px; }
.flashcard-container { perspective: 1000px; height: 330px; cursor: pointer; }
.flashcard { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 0.6s; border-radius: 12px; }
.flashcard.flipped { transform: rotateY(180deg); }
.card-front, .card-back {
    position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; backface-visibility: hidden;
    border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--card-border); background: white;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden;
}
.card-back { background: #fdfaf5; transform: rotateY(180deg); justify-content: center; align-items: center; text-align: center; border-color: var(--gold); padding: 14px; }
.hu-title { font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-size: 1.9rem; color: var(--secondary-dark); font-weight: bold; }
.hu-desc { font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--sepia); margin-top: 8px; padding: 0 4px; }
.img-container { width: 100%; height: 220px; background-color: #efe9dc; position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; }
.img-container img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; display: block; }
.audio-btn {
    position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border); border-radius: 50%; width: 30px; height: 30px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.9rem;
}
.audio-btn:hover { background: var(--primary); }
.card-front .dish-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; margin: 8px 8px 2px; text-align: center; line-height: 1.2; }
.card-front .dish-tags { padding: 0 8px 8px; text-align: center; overflow: hidden; }
.tag-badge { font-size: 0.68rem; background: #f0e6d2; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block; margin: 2px; }

/* Client cards & selectors */
.client-card { background: #fdf5f2; border: 2px dashed var(--secondary); padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
.client-avatar {
    width: 88px; height: 88px; border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover; background: white;
    border: 3px solid var(--secondary); flex-shrink: 0;
}
.client-select-box { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.client-select-box label { display: block; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--sepia); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.client-select-box select {
    width: 100%; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    font-size: 0.95rem; font-family: inherit; background: white; cursor: pointer;
}

.instruction-box { background: #eafbf7; border: 1px solid var(--primary-dark); padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 0.88rem; color: #235c52; line-height: 1.5; }

.chat-log { height: 400px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 12px; background: #fffefb; border: 1px solid var(--card-border); border-radius: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.chat-msg { max-width: 88%; padding: 11px 15px; border-radius: 14px; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.45; }
.chat-msg.chef { align-self: flex-start; background: #f0f4f8; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; color: #24292f; }
.chat-msg.client { align-self: flex-end; background: var(--primary); color: var(--dark); font-weight: 500; }

.chat-choice-panel {
    align-self: stretch; background: #fff; border: 2px solid var(--primary-dark);
    border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; margin: 4px 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}
.chat-choice-panel p { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--title); margin-bottom: 2px; }

.action-bar { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }
.btn-act { flex: 1; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; color: white; }
.btn-show { background: var(--secondary-dark); }

/* Word-tile sentence ordering */
.order-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.order-answer-row {
    min-height: 50px; background: #fdfaf5; border: 2px dashed var(--gold); border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 8px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center;
}
.order-placeholder { color: #b8ac98; font-size: 0.85rem; font-style: italic; }
.order-word-bank { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; }
.word-tile {
    background: white; border: 1px solid var(--card-border); border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--dark);
    cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s;
}
.word-tile:hover { background: #eafbf7; border-color: var(--primary-dark); }
.word-tile.placed { background: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary-dark); color: var(--dark); }
.placed-tile-wrap { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; }
.tile-move {
    background: #f0f0f0; border: 1px solid var(--card-border); border-radius: 5px;
    width: 22px; height: 22px; font-size: 0.7rem; cursor: pointer; color: var(--dark);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0;
}
.tile-move:hover { background: var(--gold); color: white; }
.tile-move:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: default; }
.order-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.order-btn {
    padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    background: white; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--dark);
}
.order-check { background: var(--title); color: white; border-color: var(--title); }
.order-check:hover { background: #0c8f7c; }
.order-clear:hover { background: #f0f0f0; }
.order-clue, .order-answer-btn { background: #fdfaf5; border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--sepia); }
.order-clue:hover, .order-answer-btn:hover { background: #f5e9d0; }
.order-btn:disabled, .word-tile:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; }
.order-feedback { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; min-height: 1.2em; }
.order-feedback-correct { color: var(--title); }
.order-feedback-wrong { color: var(--secondary-dark); }

/* Step navigation (Back / Next) for tasks */
.task-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }
.task-nav button {
    flex: 1; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    background: white; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--dark);
}
.task-nav button:hover { background: #f0f0f0; }

/* Dynamic phrase flashcard decks (words / phrases) */
.deck-section { margin-top: 16px; }
.deck-empty { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--sepia); font-style: italic; text-align: center; padding: 20px; }
.phrase-deck-wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.phrase-counter { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--sepia); font-weight: 600; }
.phrase-card-container { perspective: 1000px; width: 300px; max-width: 90%; height: 200px; margin: 0 auto; cursor: pointer; }
.phrase-card { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 0.5s; }
.phrase-card.flipped { transform: rotateY(180deg); }
.phrase-front, .phrase-back {
    position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; backface-visibility: hidden;
    border-radius: 16px; border: 2px solid var(--card-border); background: white;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center;
    padding: 18px;
}
.phrase-front-text { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--dark); line-height: 1.4; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
.phrase-hint { font-size: 0.72rem; color: #b8ac98; margin-top: 10px; font-style: italic; }
.phrase-badge { background: var(--primary-dark); color: white; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 20px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.phrase-back { background: #fdfaf5; transform: rotateY(180deg); border-color: var(--gold); font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--secondary-dark); font-weight: 700; }
.phrase-nav { display: flex; gap: 8px; width: 300px; max-width: 90%; }
.phrase-nav button { flex: 1; padding: 9px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--card-border); background: white; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--dark); }
.phrase-nav button:hover { background: #f0f0f0; }
.phrase-nav .btn-reset { background: var(--secondary); color: white; border-color: var(--secondary-dark); flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 9px 14px; }
.phrase-nav .btn-reset:hover { background: var(--secondary-dark); }

/* Mode 3: Gap Fill */
.challenge-progress { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--sepia); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.gap-sentence { font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.6; background: #f0f4f8; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.gap-blank { display: inline-block; min-width: 70px; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: var(--title); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--gold); padding: 0 4px; }
.gap-blank.gap-correct { color: var(--title); border-color: var(--title); }
.gap-blank.gap-wrong { color: var(--secondary-dark); border-color: var(--secondary-dark); }
.gap-options { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.gap-option-btn {
    padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    background: white; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--dark);
}
.gap-option-btn:hover { background: #eafbf7; border-color: var(--primary-dark); }
.gap-option-btn.gap-selected { background: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary-dark); }
.gap-option-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }

/* Mode 4: Memory Game */
.memory-toolbar { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.memory-toolbar select { padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--card-border); font-family: inherit; }
.memory-toolbar button { padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background: var(--gold); color: white; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
.memory-toolbar button:hover { background: #b88628; }
.memory-status { font-weight: 700; color: var(--title); font-family: 'Caveat', cursive; font-size: 1.4rem; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 10px; }
.memory-board { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(110px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.memory-card { perspective: 800px; height: 110px; cursor: pointer; }
.memory-card-inner { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 0.45s; }
.memory-card.memory-up .memory-card-inner { transform: rotateY(180deg); }
.memory-card-front, .memory-card-back {
    position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; backface-visibility: hidden;
    border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--card-border); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.memory-card-front { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-dark)); font-size: 2rem; }
.memory-card-back { background: white; transform: rotateY(180deg); padding: 6px; text-align: center; }
.memory-card-back img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; }
.memory-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--dark); }
.memory-card.memory-matched .memory-card-back { background: #eafbf7; border-color: var(--primary-dark); }

/* Printable blank menu template */
#printableMenu { display: none; }
#printableMenuImg { display: none; }
@media print {
    body > *:not(#printableMenu) { display: none !important; }
    #printableMenu { display: block !important; width: 100%; text-align: center; }
    #printableMenuImg { display: inline-block !important; width: 100%; max-width: 100%; height: auto; page-break-inside: avoid; }
}

</style>
</head>
<body>

    <header>
        <div>
            <h1>Order Up!</h1>
            <div style="color:var(--sepia); font-weight:600;">🇬🇧 British English Restaurant Practice (Level A2)</div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn-print" onclick="printMenu()">🖨️ Print Menu to Create</button>
    </header>

    <details class="app-guide">
        <summary>ℹ️ How to use this app (Click to open/close)</summary>
        <p>
            <b>1. Learn Dishes:</b> Pick a cuisine and a category. Click 🔊 to hear the word, or tap a card for the Hungarian translation.<br>
            <b>2. Roleplay:</b> Pick a guest. Build their reply by tapping the words in order, then press Check. Move a word with ◀ ▶, or press Show Clue / Show Answer for help. Learn the guest's own words and phrases on the left.<br>
            <b>3. Gap Fill:</b> Pick a guest. One word is missing from their sentence — tap the right word to fill the gap.<br>
            <b>4. Memory Game:</b> Pick a cuisine and match each food photo with its name.<br>
            <b>🖨️ Print your own menu:</b> Click "Print Menu to Create" to print a blank menu template — design your own restaurant's menu!
        </p>
    </details>

    <div class="mode-nav">
        <button class="mode-btn active" id="btnMode1" onclick="setMode('learn')">1️⃣ Learn Dishes</button>
        <button class="mode-btn" id="btnMode2" onclick="setMode('chef')">2️⃣ Roleplay</button>
        <button class="mode-btn" id="btnMode3" onclick="setMode('gapfill')">3️⃣ Gap Fill</button>
        <button class="mode-btn" id="btnMode4" onclick="setMode('memory')">4️⃣ Memory Game</button>
    </div>

    <!-- MODE 1: Learn Dishes -->
    <div id="modeLearn" class="dashboard">
        <div class="panel panel-full">
            <h2>🌍 1. Select Cuisine</h2>
            <p style="font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--sepia); margin-bottom:6px;">Choose a country, then a category, to see its dishes.</p>
            <select id="cuisineSelect" style="width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; padding: 8px; border-radius:6px;" onchange="onCuisineChange()">
                <option value="Italian">Italian 🇮🇹</option>
                <option value="French">French 🇫🇷</option>
                <option value="Mexican">Mexican 🇲🇽</option>
                <option value="Greek">Greek 🇬🇷</option>
                <option value="Spanish">Spanish 🇪🇸</option>
                <option value="British">British 🇬🇧</option>
            </select>

            <h2 style="margin-top: 14px;">📂 2. Select Category</h2>
            <div class="category-tabs" id="categoryTabs"></div>
            <div class="cat-meaning" id="catMeaningText"></div>

            <p style="font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--sepia); text-align:center; margin-bottom:6px;">💡 Click 🔊 for audio, or flip the card to see the Hungarian translation!</p>
            <div class="dish-grid" id="dishGrid"></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MODE 2: Roleplay -->
    <div id="modeChef" class="dashboard" style="display: none;">
        <div class="panel">
            <h2>👤 Step 1: Choose Your Guest</h2>
            <div class="instruction-box">Pick a guest. You are the waiter — help them order a starter, a main course, a dessert, and a drink.</div>
            <div class="client-select-box">
                <label for="clientSelect">Select a guest to serve:</label>
                <select id="clientSelect" onchange="onClientSelectChange()"></select>
            </div>
            <div class="client-card" id="clientCard"></div>

            <div class="deck-section">
                <h3>📖 Words from this conversation</h3>
                <p style="font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--sepia); margin-bottom:6px;">Tap to flip. Use Next / Back to browse, or Reset to shuffle.</p>
                <div class="phrase-deck-wrap">
                    <div class="phrase-counter" id="wordCounter"></div>
                    <div id="wordDeck"></div>
                    <div class="phrase-nav">
                        <button onclick="deckBack('word')">◀ Back</button>
                        <button onclick="deckNext('word')">Next ▶</button>
                        <button class="btn-reset" onclick="resetDeck('word')">🔀 Reset</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div class="deck-section">
                <h3>💬 Phrases from this conversation</h3>
                <p style="font-size:0.8rem; color:var(--sepia); margin-bottom:6px;">Every line the waiter and the guest use, just for this dialogue.</p>
                <div class="phrase-deck-wrap">
                    <div class="phrase-counter" id="phraseCounter"></div>
                    <div id="phraseDeck"></div>
                    <div class="phrase-nav">
                        <button onclick="deckBack('phrase')">◀ Back</button>
                        <button onclick="deckNext('phrase')">Next ▶</button>
                        <button class="btn-reset" onclick="resetDeck('phrase')">🔀 Reset</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="panel">
            <h2>💬 Step 2: The Conversation</h2>
            <div class="instruction-box">Tap the words to build the guest's reply, in order. Press Check ✅. Correct answers move the story forward!</div>
            <div class="chat-log" id="chatLog"></div>
            <div class="task-nav">
                <button onclick="orderingBack()">◀ Back</button>
                <button onclick="showHint()">💡 Show Hint</button>
                <button onclick="orderingNext()">Next ▶</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MODE 3: Gap Fill -->
    <div id="modeGapFill" class="dashboard" style="display: none;">
        <div class="panel panel-full">
            <h2>✏️ Gap Fill</h2>
            <div class="instruction-box">Pick a guest. One word is missing from their sentence. Tap the correct word to fill the gap.</div>
            <div class="client-select-box">
                <label for="gapClientSelect">Select a guest:</label>
                <select id="gapClientSelect" onchange="onGapClientChange()"></select>
            </div>
            <div class="client-card" id="gapClientCard"></div>
            <div id="gapArea"></div>
            <div class="task-nav">
                <button onclick="gapBack()">◀ Back</button>
                <button onclick="gapNext()">Next ▶</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MODE 4: Memory Game -->
    <div id="modeMemory" class="dashboard" style="display: none;">
        <div class="panel panel-full">
            <h2>🧠 Memory Game</h2>
            <div class="instruction-box">Pick a cuisine. Flip two cards at a time. Match each food's photo with its name!</div>
            <div class="memory-toolbar">
                <label for="memoryCuisineSelect" style="font-weight:700; font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--sepia);">Cuisine:</label>
                <select id="memoryCuisineSelect" onchange="newMemoryGame()"></select>
                <button onclick="newMemoryGame()">🔀 New Game</button>
                <span id="memoryMoves" style="font-weight:700; color:var(--sepia); font-size:0.85rem;"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="memory-board" id="memoryBoard"></div>
            <div class="memory-status" id="memoryStatus"></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Hidden printable blank menu, shown only by the print stylesheet -->
    <div id="printableMenu">
        <img id="printableMenuImg" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Blank menu template">
    </div>

    <!-- Load App Scripts -->
    <script>
// ============================================================================
// RESTAURANT ROLE-PLAY DATA — A2 English learners — "Order Up!"
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// - Six cuisines x 24 dishes each, plain pronounceable English names.
// - 9 clients, cartoon avatars (img is an inline SVG data URI, not a photo).
// - Each dialogue step with a guest turn now has a single SHORT (6-11 word)
//   target sentence in "answer" (plus "hu" translation) instead of a
//   multiple-choice array — used for the sentence-ordering exercises.
//   "chef" is the waiter's given line (null for reaction turns, where the
//   waiter's line is generated dynamically by app.js after offering a dish).
// - requiresSuggest steps unchanged: { category, filterTag }.
// - Vocabulary/phrase flashcards are now built dynamically in app.js from
//   the currently selected client's own dialogue (chef lines + answers),
//   not a separate static bank — see buildDialoguePhraseDeck() in app.js.
// ============================================================================

const categories = ["Starters", "Mains", "Sides", "Desserts", "Drinks", "Special of the Week"];

const categoryMeanings = {

            { requiresSuggest: true, category: "Mains", filterTag: "hearty" },

            { requiresSuggest: true, category: "Desserts" },

</script>
    <script>
let currentCategory = "Starters";
let currentClient = clients[0];
let currentTurn = 0;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Printing: a fixed blank menu template image, embedded in the page and
// hidden on screen, shown only via a print stylesheet.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function printMenu() {
    window.print();
}

function escJs(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/'/g, "\\'");
}

function playAudio(text, e) {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    if ('speechSynthesis' in window) {
        window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
        const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
        utterance.lang = 'en-GB';
        utterance.rate = 0.9;
        window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
    }
}

function setMode(mode) {
    document.getElementById('modeLearn').style.display = mode === 'learn' ? 'grid' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('modeChef').style.display = mode === 'chef' ? 'grid' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('modeGapFill').style.display = mode === 'gapfill' ? 'grid' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('modeMemory').style.display = mode === 'memory' ? 'grid' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('btnMode1').classList.toggle('active', mode === 'learn');
    document.getElementById('btnMode2').classList.toggle('active', mode === 'chef');
    document.getElementById('btnMode3').classList.toggle('active', mode === 'gapfill');
    document.getElementById('btnMode4').classList.toggle('active', mode === 'memory');
    if (mode === 'chef') {
        populateClientSelect('clientSelect');
        startClient(document.getElementById('clientSelect').value);
    }
    if (mode === 'gapfill') {
        populateClientSelect('gapClientSelect');
        startGapFill(document.getElementById('gapClientSelect').value);
    }
    if (mode === 'memory') {
        startMemoryGame();
    }
}

function onCuisineChange() {
    renderCategories();
    if (document.getElementById('modeChef').style.display !== 'none') {
        startClient(document.getElementById('clientSelect').value);
    }
}

function renderCategories() {
    const tabs = document.getElementById('categoryTabs');
    tabs.innerHTML = categories.map(cat =>
        `<button class="cat-btn ${cat === currentCategory ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="selectCategory('${escJs(cat)}')">${cat}</button>`
    ).join('');

    document.getElementById('catMeaningText').innerText = `${currentCategory}: ${categoryMeanings[currentCategory]}`;
    renderDishes();
}

function selectCategory(cat) {
    currentCategory = cat;
    renderCategories();
}

function renderDishes() {
    const cuis = document.getElementById('cuisineSelect').value;
    const dishes = (menuData[cuis][currentCategory] || []).slice(0, 4);
    const grid = document.getElementById('dishGrid');

    grid.innerHTML = dishes.map(d => `
        <div class="flashcard-container" onclick="this.querySelector('.flashcard').classList.toggle('flipped')">
            <div class="flashcard">
                <div class="card-front">
                    <div class="img-container">
                        <img src="${d.img}" alt="${d.name}" loading="lazy">
                        <button class="audio-btn" onclick="playAudio('${escJs(d.name)}', event)" title="Listen Pronunciation">🔊</button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="dish-name">${d.name}</div>
                    <div class="dish-tags">${d.tags.map(t => `<span class="tag-badge">${t}</span>`).join(' ')}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="card-back">
                    <div class="hu-title">${d.hu}</div>
                    <div class="hu-desc">${d.huDesc}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `).join('');
}

function getAllDishesWithCategory(cuisOverride) {
    const cuis = cuisOverride || document.getElementById('cuisineSelect').value;
    let allDishes = [];
    categories.forEach(c => {
        (menuData[cuis][c] || []).forEach(d => allDishes.push(Object.assign({}, d, { category: c })));
    });
    return allDishes;
}

function populateClientSelect(selectId) {
    const sel = document.getElementById(selectId);
    if (sel.dataset.filled) return;
    sel.innerHTML = clients.map((c, i) =>
        `<option value="${i}">${c.name} — ${c.need}</option>`
    ).join('');
    sel.dataset.filled = '1';
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MODE 2: Chef Roleplay Dialogue (word-ordering inside the chat), now with
// Back / Next stepping and Show Clue / Show Answer helpers.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
let stepSolved = {}; // turnIndex -> true once solved (this session, this client)

function onClientSelectChange() {
    startClient(document.getElementById('clientSelect').value);
}

function startClient(indexStr) {
    currentClient = clients[parseInt(indexStr, 10)];
    currentTurn = 0;
    stepSolved = {};

    document.getElementById('clientCard').innerHTML = `
        <img src="${currentClient.img}" class="client-avatar">
        <div>
            <h3>${currentClient.name}</h3>
            <p style="font-size:0.85rem; margin-top:2px;"><b>What they want:</b> <span style="color:var(--secondary-dark); font-weight:700;">${currentClient.need}</span></p>
        </div>
    `;

    document.getElementById('chatLog').innerHTML = '';

    buildDialoguePhraseDecks();
    addChat('chef', currentClient.dialogue[0].chef);
    renderOrderingTurn();
}

function addChat(sender, text) {
    const log = document.getElementById('chatLog');
    const msg = document.createElement('div');
    msg.className = `chat-msg ${sender}`;
    msg.innerText = (sender === 'chef' ? '👨‍🍳 Waiter: ' : `👤 ${currentClient.name}: `) + text;
    log.appendChild(msg);
    log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
}

// Finds the previous/next guest-turn step index (skipping requiresSuggest steps)
function findGuestTurnIndex(fromIndex, direction) {
    let i = fromIndex + direction;
    while (i >= 0 && i < currentClient.dialogue.length) {
        if (!currentClient.dialogue[i].requiresSuggest) return i;
        i += direction;
    }
    return -1;
}

function orderingBack() {
    const prev = findGuestTurnIndex(currentTurn, -1);
    if (prev === -1) { alert("You're already at the first question."); return; }
    currentTurn = prev;
    refreshPhraseHighlight();
    renderOrderingTurn();
}

function orderingNext() {
    if (!stepSolved[currentTurn]) {
        alert("Please complete this one first — or press Show Answer for help.");
        return;
    }
    const next = findGuestTurnIndex(currentTurn, 1);
    if (next === -1) { alert("You've reached the last question in this dialogue!"); return; }
    currentTurn = next;
    refreshPhraseHighlight();
    renderOrderingTurn();
}

function renderOrderingTurn() {
    const log = document.getElementById('chatLog');
    const existing = document.getElementById('activeOrderPanel');
    if (existing) existing.remove();

    const turnData = currentClient.dialogue[currentTurn];
    if (!turnData || turnData.requiresSuggest) return;

    const panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.className = 'chat-choice-panel';
    panel.id = 'activeOrderPanel';
    panel.innerHTML = `<p>🧩 Put ${currentClient.name}'s reply in the right order:</p>`;
    log.appendChild(panel);
    log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;

    buildWordOrderUI(panel, turnData.answer, () => {
        stepSolved[currentTurn] = true;
        panel.remove();
        addChat('client', turnData.answer);
        currentTurn++;
        refreshPhraseHighlight();
        advanceDialogue();
    });
}

function advanceDialogue() {
    if (currentTurn >= currentClient.dialogue.length) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            const panel = document.createElement('div');
            panel.style.cssText = "background:#eafbf7; border:1px solid var(--primary-dark); padding:10px; border-radius:10px; text-align:center; font-weight:700; color:var(--title); margin-top:8px;";
            panel.innerText = "✅ Dialogue Completed Successfully!";
            document.getElementById('chatLog').appendChild(panel);
        }, 500);
        return;
    }

    const nextTurn = currentClient.dialogue[currentTurn];
    if (nextTurn.requiresSuggest) {
        setTimeout(() => waiterOffersDish(nextTurn), 500);
    } else if (!nextTurn.chef) {
        renderOrderingTurn();
    } else {
        setTimeout(() => {
            addChat('chef', nextTurn.chef);
            renderOrderingTurn();
        }, 500);
    }
}

const OFFER_TEMPLATES = [
    (course, dish) => `For your ${course}, may I suggest our ${dish}?`,
    (course, dish) => `How about our ${dish} for your ${course}?`,
    (course, dish) => `I'd recommend the ${dish} for your ${course}.`,
    (course, dish) => `The ${dish} would be wonderful for your ${course}.`,
    (course, dish) => `Our ${dish} is very popular — perfect for your ${course}.`,
    (course, dish) => `Let me suggest the ${dish} for your ${course}.`,
];
const REASON_TEMPLATES = [
    (tag) => `It's ${tag}, so it's perfect for you.`,
    (tag) => `It's ${tag} — just what you asked for.`,
    (tag) => `That one is ${tag}, so you're in good hands.`,
    (tag) => `It ticks the ${tag} box nicely.`,
    (tag) => `You'll find it's fully ${tag}.`,
];
const NO_TAG_REASONS = [
    ' I think you will really enjoy it.',
    " It's one of our favourites here.",
    ' I have a feeling you will love it.',
    " It's always a hit with our guests.",
];

function waiterOffersDish(turnData) {
    const allDishes = getAllDishesWithCategory();
    const matches = allDishes.filter(d =>
        d.category === turnData.category &&
        (!turnData.filterTag || d.tags.includes(turnData.filterTag))
    );

    const dish = matches.length
        ? matches[Math.floor(Math.random() * matches.length)]
        : null;

    if (dish) {
        const template = OFFER_TEMPLATES[Math.floor(Math.random() * OFFER_TEMPLATES.length)];
        const offerLine = template(turnData.category.toLowerCase(), dish.name);
        let reasonBit;
        if (turnData.filterTag) {
            const reasonTemplate = REASON_TEMPLATES[Math.floor(Math.random() * REASON_TEMPLATES.length)];
            reasonBit = ' ' + reasonTemplate(turnData.filterTag);
        } else {
            reasonBit = NO_TAG_REASONS[Math.floor(Math.random() * NO_TAG_REASONS.length)];
        }
        addChat('chef', offerLine + reasonBit);
    } else {
        addChat('chef', `Let me check with the kitchen about a good ${turnData.category.toLowerCase()} option for you.`);
    }

    currentTurn++;
    refreshPhraseHighlight();
    advanceDialogue();
}

function showHint() {
    const turnData = currentClient.dialogue[currentTurn];
    if (!turnData) return;
    if (turnData.requiresSuggest) {
        alert(`Hint: The waiter is about to suggest a ${turnData.category} dish that suits ${currentClient.name}. Just wait a moment!`);
    } else {
        alert(`Hint: Look at the words below and build ${currentClient.name}'s reply in order.`);
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Reusable word-tile sentence-ordering widget, now with Show Clue, Show
// Answer, and ◀ ▶ move buttons on each placed tile for easy reordering
// (no need to remove a word just to shift it one place).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function buildWordOrderUI(container, targetSentence, onCorrect) {
    const tiles = targetSentence.split(' ').map((w, i) => ({ id: i, word: w }));
    const shuffled = tiles.slice().sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());
    let placed = [];
    let solved = false;

    const wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'order-wrap';
    wrap.innerHTML = `
        <div class="order-answer-row"></div>
        <div class="order-word-bank"></div>
        <div class="order-actions">
            <button class="order-btn order-check">Check ✅</button>
            <button class="order-btn order-clear">Clear ↺</button>
            <button class="order-btn order-clue">💡 Show Clue</button>
            <button class="order-btn order-answer-btn">👀 Show Answer</button>
        </div>
        <div class="order-feedback"></div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(wrap);

    const answerRow = wrap.querySelector('.order-answer-row');
    const bank = wrap.querySelector('.order-word-bank');
    const feedback = wrap.querySelector('.order-feedback');

    function draw() {
        answerRow.innerHTML = placed.length
            ? placed.map((id, pos) => `
                <span class="placed-tile-wrap">
                    <button class="tile-move" data-pos="${pos}" data-dir="-1" ${pos === 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>◀</button>
                    <button class="word-tile placed" data-id="${id}">${tiles[id].word}</button>
                    <button class="tile-move" data-pos="${pos}" data-dir="1" ${pos === placed.length - 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}>▶</button>
                </span>`).join('')
            : `<span class="order-placeholder">Tap the words below, in order…</span>`;
        bank.innerHTML = shuffled
            .filter(t => !placed.includes(t.id))
            .map(t => `<button class="word-tile" data-id="${t.id}">${t.word}</button>`).join('');

        bank.querySelectorAll('.word-tile').forEach(btn => {
            btn.onclick = () => { placed.push(parseInt(btn.dataset.id, 10)); feedback.innerText = ''; draw(); };
        });
        answerRow.querySelectorAll('.word-tile.placed').forEach(btn => {
            btn.onclick = () => { placed = placed.filter(id => id !== parseInt(btn.dataset.id, 10)); feedback.innerText = ''; draw(); };
        });
        answerRow.querySelectorAll('.tile-move').forEach(btn => {
            btn.onclick = (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                const pos = parseInt(btn.dataset.pos, 10);
                const dir = parseInt(btn.dataset.dir, 10);
                const swapWith = pos + dir;
                if (swapWith < 0 || swapWith >= placed.length) return;
                [placed[pos], placed[swapWith]] = [placed[swapWith], placed[pos]];
                draw();
            };
        });
    }
    draw();

    wrap.querySelector('.order-clear').onclick = () => { placed = []; feedback.innerText = ''; draw(); };

    wrap.querySelector('.order-clue').onclick = () => {
        feedback.className = 'order-feedback';
        feedback.innerText = `💡 Clue: the first word is "${tiles[0].word}"`;
    };

    wrap.querySelector('.order-answer-btn').onclick = () => {
        if (solved) return;
        solved = true;
        placed = tiles.map(t => t.id);
        draw();
        feedback.className = 'order-feedback order-feedback-correct';
        feedback.innerText = 'Here is the answer:';
        wrap.querySelectorAll('.word-tile, .order-btn, .tile-move').forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
        setTimeout(onCorrect, 900);
    };

    wrap.querySelector('.order-check').onclick = () => {
        if (solved) return;
        const attempt = placed.map(id => tiles[id].word).join(' ');
        if (attempt === targetSentence) {
            solved = true;
            feedback.className = 'order-feedback order-feedback-correct';
            feedback.innerText = '✅ Correct!';
            wrap.querySelectorAll('.word-tile, .order-btn, .tile-move').forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
            setTimeout(onCorrect, 500);
        } else if (placed.length < tiles.length) {
            feedback.className = 'order-feedback order-feedback-wrong';
            feedback.innerText = 'Not finished yet — use all the words!';
        } else {
            feedback.className = 'order-feedback order-feedback-wrong';
            feedback.innerText = '❌ Not quite the right order — try again!';
        }
    };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Dynamic phrase flashcards (Mode 2 side panel): built from the CURRENT
// client's own dialogue only, split into WORDS and PHRASES decks.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
let PHRASE_DECKS = {
    word: { items: [], order: [], index: 0 },
    phrase: { items: [], order: [], index: 0 }
};

const KEY_WORDS = [
    "starter", "main course", "dessert", "drink",
    "allergy", "vegetarian", "gluten-free", "lactose", "dairy", "nut",
    "hearty", "light", "filling", "appetite", "meat"
];

const HU_WORD_LOOKUP = {
    "starter": "előétel", "main course": "főétel", "dessert": "desszert", "drink": "ital",
    "allergy": "allergia", "vegetarian": "vegetáriánus", "gluten-free": "gluténmentes",
    "lactose": "laktóz", "dairy": "tejtermék", "nut": "dió/mogyoró", "hearty": "laktató",
    "light": "könnyű", "filling": "laktató", "appetite": "étvágy", "meat": "hús"
};

function shuffledIndices(n) {
    const arr = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => i);
    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
        [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
    }
    return arr;
}

function buildDialoguePhraseDecks() {
    const phrases = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    currentClient.dialogue.forEach(step => {
        if (step.chef && !seen.has(step.chef)) {
            seen.add(step.chef);
            phrases.push({ en: step.chef, hu: '', speaker: 'waiter' });
        }
        if (step.answer && !seen.has(step.answer)) {
            seen.add(step.answer);
            phrases.push({ en: step.answer, hu: step.hu || '', speaker: 'guest' });
        }
    });

    const allText = phrases.map(p => p.en.toLowerCase()).join(' | ');
    const words = KEY_WORDS.filter(w => allText.includes(w)).map(w => ({
        en: w, hu: HU_WORD_LOOKUP[w] || '', type: 'word'
    }));

    PHRASE_DECKS.word.items = words;
    PHRASE_DECKS.phrase.items = phrases;
    resetDeck('word');
    resetDeck('phrase');
}

function resetDeck(key) {
    const deck = PHRASE_DECKS[key];
    deck.order = shuffledIndices(deck.items.length);
    deck.index = 0;
    renderDeckCard(key);
}

function deckNext(key) {
    const deck = PHRASE_DECKS[key];
    if (!deck.order.length) return;
    deck.index = (deck.index + 1) % deck.order.length;
    renderDeckCard(key);
}

function deckBack(key) {
    const deck = PHRASE_DECKS[key];
    if (!deck.order.length) return;
    deck.index = (deck.index - 1 + deck.order.length) % deck.order.length;
    renderDeckCard(key);
}

function refreshPhraseHighlight() {
    renderDeckCard('word');
    renderDeckCard('phrase');
}

function renderDeckCard(key) {
    const deck = PHRASE_DECKS[key];
    const counterEl = document.getElementById(key + 'Counter');
    const deckEl = document.getElementById(key + 'Deck');
    if (!deckEl) return;

    if (!deck.items.length) {
        counterEl.innerText = '';
        deckEl.innerHTML = `<p class="deck-empty">No ${key === 'word' ? 'key words' : 'phrases'} for this guest yet.</p>`;
        return;
    }

    const p = deck.items[deck.order[deck.index]];
    counterEl.innerText = `${deck.index + 1} / ${deck.order.length}`;
    const speakerTag = p.speaker === 'waiter' ? '👨‍🍳 Waiter' : (p.speaker === 'guest' ? `👤 ${currentClient.name}` : '');

    deckEl.innerHTML = `
        <div class="phrase-card-container" onclick="this.querySelector('.phrase-card').classList.toggle('flipped')">
            <div class="phrase-card">
                <div class="phrase-front">
                    ${speakerTag ? `<div class="phrase-badge">${speakerTag}</div>` : ''}
                    <div class="phrase-front-text">${p.en}</div>
                    <div class="phrase-hint">tap to flip</div>
                </div>
                <div class="phrase-back">${p.hu || '—'}</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    `;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MODE 3: Gap Fill — the guest's line is shown with one word missing;
// choose the right word from a few options. Back / Next, Show Clue, Show
// Answer all included. Advances automatically only once correct.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
let gapClient = null;
let gapItems = [];
let gapIndex = 0;
let gapSolved = {};

function onGapClientChange() {
    startGapFill(document.getElementById('gapClientSelect').value);
}

function startGapFill(indexStr) {
    gapClient = clients[parseInt(indexStr, 10)];
    gapItems = gapFill[gapClient.name] || [];
    gapIndex = 0;
    gapSolved = {};

    document.getElementById('gapClientCard').innerHTML = `
        <img src="${gapClient.img}" class="client-avatar">
        <div>
            <h3>${gapClient.name}</h3>
            <p style="font-size:0.85rem; margin-top:2px;"><b>What they want:</b> <span style="color:var(--secondary-dark); font-weight:700;">${gapClient.need}</span></p>
        </div>
    `;
    renderGapStep();
}

function gapBack() {
    if (gapIndex === 0) { alert("You're already at the first question."); return; }
    gapIndex--;
    renderGapStep();
}

function gapNext() {
    if (!gapSolved[gapIndex]) { alert("Please fill the gap correctly first — or press Show Answer."); return; }
    if (gapIndex >= gapItems.length - 1) { alert("You've reached the last question!"); return; }
    gapIndex++;
    renderGapStep();
}

function renderGapStep() {
    const box = document.getElementById('gapArea');
    if (!gapItems.length) {
        box.innerHTML = `<p class="deck-empty">No gap-fill questions for this guest.</p>`;
        return;
    }

    const item = gapItems[gapIndex];
    const parts = item.sentence.split('___');
    let solved = gapSolved[gapIndex] === true;
    let chosen = null;

    const optionsShuffled = item.options.slice().sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());

    box.innerHTML = `
        <div class="challenge-progress">Question ${gapIndex + 1} of ${gapItems.length}</div>
        <div class="gap-sentence" id="gapSentence">${parts[0]}<span class="gap-blank" id="gapBlank">___</span>${parts[1] || ''}</div>
        <div class="gap-options" id="gapOptions">
            ${optionsShuffled.map(o => `<button class="gap-option-btn" data-word="${escJs(o)}">${o}</button>`).join('')}
        </div>
        <div class="order-actions" style="margin-top:10px;">
            <button class="order-btn" id="gapClueBtn">💡 Show Clue</button>
            <button class="order-btn" id="gapAnswerBtn">👀 Show Answer</button>
        </div>
        <div class="order-feedback" id="gapFeedback"></div>
    `;

    const blankEl = document.getElementById('gapBlank');
    const feedback = document.getElementById('gapFeedback');

    document.querySelectorAll('.gap-option-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.onclick = () => {
            if (solved) return;
            document.querySelectorAll('.gap-option-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('gap-selected'));
            btn.classList.add('gap-selected');
            chosen = btn.dataset.word;
            blankEl.innerText = chosen;

            if (chosen === item.answer) {
                solved = true;
                gapSolved[gapIndex] = true;
                blankEl.classList.add('gap-correct');
                feedback.className = 'order-feedback order-feedback-correct';
                feedback.innerText = '✅ Correct!';
                document.querySelectorAll('.gap-option-btn').forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
            } else {
                blankEl.classList.add('gap-wrong');
                feedback.className = 'order-feedback order-feedback-wrong';
                feedback.innerText = '❌ Not quite — try another word!';
                setTimeout(() => { blankEl.innerText = '___'; blankEl.classList.remove('gap-wrong'); }, 700);
            }
        };
    });

    document.getElementById('gapClueBtn').onclick = () => {
        feedback.className = 'order-feedback';
        feedback.innerText = `💡 Clue: the word starts with "${item.answer[0].toUpperCase()}" and has ${item.answer.length} letters.`;
    };

    document.getElementById('gapAnswerBtn').onclick = () => {
        if (solved) return;
        solved = true;
        gapSolved[gapIndex] = true;
        blankEl.innerText = item.answer;
        blankEl.classList.add('gap-correct');
        feedback.className = 'order-feedback order-feedback-correct';
        feedback.innerText = 'Here is the answer.';
        document.querySelectorAll('.gap-option-btn').forEach(b => b.disabled = true);
    };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// MODE 4: Memory Game — match each dish's photo card with its name card,
// using the currently selected cuisine's food and drink dishes.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
let memoryFlipped = [];
let memoryMatched = [];
let memoryCards = [];
let memoryLock = false;
let memoryMoves = 0;

function startMemoryGame() {
    populateMemoryCuisineSelect();
    newMemoryGame();
}

function populateMemoryCuisineSelect() {
    const sel = document.getElementById('memoryCuisineSelect');
    if (sel.dataset.filled) return;
    sel.innerHTML = `
        <option value="Italian">Italian 🇮🇹</option>
        <option value="French">French 🇫🇷</option>
        <option value="Mexican">Mexican 🇲🇽</option>
        <option value="Greek">Greek 🇬🇷</option>
        <option value="Spanish">Spanish 🇪🇸</option>
        <option value="British">British 🇬🇧</option>
    `;
    sel.dataset.filled = '1';
}

function newMemoryGame() {
    const cuis = document.getElementById('memoryCuisineSelect').value;
    const foodAndDrink = getAllDishesWithCategory(cuis).filter(d => d.category === 'Desserts' || d.category === 'Drinks' || d.category === 'Mains' || d.category === 'Starters');
    const shuffledDishes = foodAndDrink.slice().sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random()).slice(0, 6);

    let cardId = 0;
    memoryCards = [];
    shuffledDishes.forEach((d, pairIndex) => {
        memoryCards.push({ id: cardId++, pairIndex, kind: 'image', dish: d });
        memoryCards.push({ id: cardId++, pairIndex, kind: 'name', dish: d });
    });
    memoryCards.sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());

    memoryFlipped = [];
    memoryMatched = [];
    memoryLock = false;
    memoryMoves = 0;
    renderMemoryBoard();
}

function renderMemoryBoard() {
    const board = document.getElementById('memoryBoard');
    document.getElementById('memoryMoves').innerText = `Moves: ${memoryMoves}`;
    board.innerHTML = memoryCards.map(c => {
        const isUp = memoryFlipped.includes(c.id) || memoryMatched.includes(c.pairIndex);
        const content = c.kind === 'image'
            ? `<img src="${c.dish.img}" alt="${c.dish.name}">`
            : `<span class="memory-name">${c.dish.name}</span>`;
        return `
        <div class="memory-card ${isUp ? 'memory-up' : ''} ${memoryMatched.includes(c.pairIndex) ? 'memory-matched' : ''}" onclick="flipMemoryCard(${c.id})">
            <div class="memory-card-inner">
                <div class="memory-card-front">❓</div>
                <div class="memory-card-back">${content}</div>
            </div>
        </div>`;
    }).join('');
}

function flipMemoryCard(id) {
    if (memoryLock) return;
    const card = memoryCards.find(c => c.id === id);
    if (!card || memoryFlipped.includes(id) || memoryMatched.includes(card.pairIndex)) return;

    memoryFlipped.push(id);
    renderMemoryBoard();

    if (memoryFlipped.length === 2) {
        memoryMoves++;
        memoryLock = true;
        const [id1, id2] = memoryFlipped;
        const c1 = memoryCards.find(c => c.id === id1);
        const c2 = memoryCards.find(c => c.id === id2);

        if (c1.pairIndex === c2.pairIndex) {
            memoryMatched.push(c1.pairIndex);
            memoryFlipped = [];
            memoryLock = false;
            renderMemoryBoard();
            if (memoryMatched.length === memoryCards.length / 2) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    document.getElementById('memoryStatus').innerText = `🏆 Well done! You matched everything in ${memoryMoves} moves.`;
                }, 300);
            }
        } else {
            setTimeout(() => {
                memoryFlipped = [];
                memoryLock = false;
                renderMemoryBoard();
            }, 900);
        }
    }
}

window.onload = () => {
    renderCategories();
};

</script>
</body>
</html>
